scope: Hand-set consistency thresholds. Fusion is a consistency detector, not a spoofing classifier. Model B is an activity classifier not trained on spoofing. No ML training in the fusion layer; values are quantiles of genuine Dryad walking measured on calibration subjects only.

aggregation.model_b_windows: probability mean over Model B windows (128 samples at 50 Hz, stride 64) lying fully inside the decision window
aggregation.imu_class: argmax of the mean probabilities; ties STATIONARY > WALKING > OTHER
aggregation.majority_vote: not used (reported nowhere); probability mean keeps the class margin available to the rules

persistence.rule: reported state changes to a decisive state after N consecutive identical raw states; UNCERTAIN/INSUFFICIENT_DATA are reported immediately

ACC_MAX_M.meaning: mean GPS confInterval of the window above which the window is INSUFFICIENT_DATA

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

ACC_MAX_M.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects)

COV_MIN.meaning: minimum fraction of the 5 s window covered by kept GPS fixes

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

COV_MIN.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects)

V_MOVE_MPS.meaning: GPS reported speed (window median) at or above which GPS movement is 'significant'. Also the still/moving boundary: the still side is provisional (no live stationary calibration data)

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

V_MOVE_MPS.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects); still side: provisional (no live stationary calibration data)

V_MOVE_DISP_MPS.meaning: displacement / covered seconds at or above which displacement movement is 'significant'; still side provisional (no live stationary calibration data)

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

V_MOVE_DISP_MPS.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects); still side: provisional (no live stationary calibration data)

V_WALK_MAX_MPS.meaning: GPS speed above which movement is outside the pedestrian envelope (running / cycling / vehicle) -> UNCERTAIN

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

V_WALK_MAX_MPS.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects)

STEP_MIN.meaning: physical step increase counted as 'steps increase'
STEP_MIN.quantity: physical step increment per 5 s window (running max of steps.csv)

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

STEP_MIN.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects)

P_STAT_SUSPICIOUS.meaning: mean Model B P(STATIONARY) required for SUSPICIOUS (never below 0.5)
P_STAT_SUSPICIOUS.quantity: mean P_stationary of Model B windows in the decision window

provenance.dataset: Dryad (real, genuine hand-held walking; no spoofing)

P_STAT_SUSPICIOUS.status: calibrated on Dryad genuine hand-held walking (calibration subjects)

STEP_ZERO_MAX.meaning: physical step increase counted as 'steps ~0' (one spurious pedometer step tolerated)

provenance.dataset: hand-set design constant; no real stationary pedometer data in the repository

P_STAT_STATIONARY.meaning: mean Model B P(STATIONARY) required for the STATIONARY state (majority)

provenance.dataset: hand-set design constant; Dryad has no stationary windows, Model B STATIONARY recall on this domain is unknown

MIN_IMU_WINDOWS.meaning: minimum Model B windows fully inside the decision window

provenance.dataset: design constant (a 5 s window holds at most 2 windows of 2.56 s at stride 1.28 s)
